The price remains in the middle of its short-term range, lacking a clear directional bias. Risk has decreased from 8.2 to 7.5, driven by the price moving within Bollinger Bands and consolidating around the SMA20, reducing immediate downside pressure despite the bearish candle pattern and moderate volatility increase (ATR 3.01%).
